lead_in: @Srikant Sulpule Fix is ready for QA retest on the latest Accounting deploy for this ticket (Obs1–3 + multi-child force-bill uniqueness).

rca.situation: After last-child death foreclosure on a group parent, QA saw missing parent force-bill on the statement, Summary interest showing zero or mismatched Accrued vs Original, and excess still visible after principal netting. A later multi-child same-day case also collided on the parent force-bill reference.
rca.cause: Parent last-child path did not always post a dedicated parent partial-cycle force-bill; parent accrued was not reconciled to billed original; parent reschedule payment kept a separate excess component after overpayment was already netted into principal; parent force-bill reference reused only account id + reporting time, so two child claims on the same day collided.
rca.resolution: Parent force-bill is posted on the death-foreclosure path; Accrued is reconciled to Original for Summary; reschedule excess is zero after principal netting; force-bill reference is unique per child claim. Local Dev Verification re-ran the full acceptance checklist under a fail-closed harness (printed FAIL exits non-zero).

Unchanged: non-last child path still allows payment-row amount to differ from principal while transaction amounts match (product decision pending — see Notes).
Edge: ₹1 future-schedule interest parent vs remaining member remains open for product decision (fix vs tolerance). Parent residual interest stays Out-of-scope for this ticket.
